description: This file defines a Migration class for version 4.1.2.1 of the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract migration class and includes methods to perform database migrations (though none are implemented in this version) and to return the version number.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a specific database migration for version 4.1.2.1, extending the AbstractMigration class and implementing the 'up' and 'getVersion' methods.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration or upgrade steps; in this case, no database changes are made.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.1.2.1' for this migration.
